system:
INTENT CONTRACT
Split the request into hard constraints (field/op/value, filters) and preferences (field/direction/weight, scores). Ask a clarifying question only when a constraint is unusable.

recordings.BUYER\nsomething good for espresso, chea: {"constraints": [{"field": "brew_method", "op": "eq", "value": "espresso"}], "preferences": [{"field": "price_usd", "direction": "min", "weight": 1.0}], "clarifying_question": "What is the most you would want to spend per 12 oz bag?"}
